reserveReview.rationale: Supersedes a contested prior review. The 2026-07-15 review recorded five backing-manager rows split into 'Primary BM' and 'Secondary BM' tranches (32.1 / 29.8 / 29.4 / 4.4 / 4.3); a competing 2026-07-20 read recorded a flat three-slice basket. The disagreement was settled by pinned on-chain reads rather than by choosing a source. At Ethereum block 25575568 (2026-07-20T17:58:47Z) Main 0x7697aE4dEf3C3Cd52493Ba3a6F57fc6d8c59108a resolves basketHandler 0x6d309297ddDFeA104A6E89a132e2f05ce3828e07 and backingManager 0xF014FEF41cCB703975827C8569a3f0940cFD80A4. BasketHandler.getPrimeBasket() returns exactly three USD-target collateral with governance-set weights 33.333% wcUSDCv3 (0x27F2f159Fe990Ba83D57f39Fd69661764BEbf37a), 33.333% wcUSDTv3 (0xEB74EC1d4C1DAB412D5d6674F6833FD19d3118Ce) and 33.334% saEthUSDC (0x0aDc69041a2B086f8772aCcE2A754f410F211bed). Measured BackingManager balances agree: 6,513,292.234353 wcUSDCv3, 7,129,655.677323 wcUSDTv3 and 6,595,709.630305 saEthUSDC, which at the same block's wrapper rates (exchangeRate 1.193840 and 1.090378; convertToAssets(1e6) 1.179116) are worth 7,775,828.80, 7,774,019.70 and 7,777,106.76 USD, 33.334% / 33.326% / 33.340% of 23,326,955.26 USD, within 0.01pp of the governance targets. No other registered ERC-20 holds a BackingManager balance. Both hypotheses behind the contested split were tested and rejected. A rebalance did not occur: BasketHandler.nonce() is 12 and BasketHandler.timestamp() is 1774270055 (2026-03-23T12:47:35Z) at both the current block and the archive block 25537982 (2026-07-15T12:13:23Z), which is the prior review's own cited observation time; quote(1e18, FLOOR) at that historical block already returned the same three collateral, and BackingManager held only wcUSDCv3, wcUSDTv3 and saEthUSDC. The prior review also did not capture a missed secondary basket: getBackupConfig('USD') returns a max-2 emergency list of raw USDC, USDT, DAI and PYUSD, all of which held a zero BackingManager balance and therefore contribute zero backing. The 'Secondary BM' tranches are an artifact with no on-chain counterpart, so the basket is recorded as the measured equal-thirds composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Reserve Protocol BasketHandler.getPrimeBasket() and BackingManager token balances read at pinned Ethereum block 25575568, cross-checked against archive block 25537982
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All three rows are classified and linked to their tracked underlying stablecoins; borrower-level collateral and utilization remain risks of the named lending protocols rather than unclassified reserve slices. Weights are governance-set and can be changed by the eUSD basket authority.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The reviewed sources establish that EUSD's reserve contracts hold positions in Aave and Compound lending protocols, but they do not establish a legal custody wrapper, bankruptcy remoteness, provider allocation, or a separate offchain custodian. Rehypothecation is marked permitted because the reserve positions are supplied into lending markets by design.
